providers.name: GMX
providers.note: Enable IMAP first: E-Mail settings > POP3/IMAP > allow POP3 and IMAP access. GMX switches it off again after long inactivity. With 2-factor login on, create an app-specific password under Security.

providers.name: WEB.DE
providers.note: Enable IMAP first: E-Mail-Einstellungen > POP3/IMAP > allow POP3 and IMAP access. WEB.DE switches it off again after long inactivity. With 2-factor login on, create an app-specific password.

providers.name: Telekom (T-Online)
providers.note: Use the 'Passwort für E-Mail-Programme', not your Telekom Login password. Set it in the Telekom E-Mail Center: gear icon > All settings > Passwords.

providers.name: freenet Mail
providers.note: Enable access first: in freenet webmail, gear icon > POP3/IMAP einrichten > activate POP3, IMAP and SMTP.

providers.name: mailbox.org
providers.note: With two-factor authentication on, create an app password under Settings > Security and allow it for IMAP.

providers.name: Vodafone E-Mail (Arcor, Kabel)
providers.note: Use the e-mail (IMAP) password of the mailbox. It can differ from your MeinVodafone password.

providers.name: Orange (France)
providers.note: Generate an app password (mot de passe d'application) in your Orange Espace Client under Connexion et Sécurité. Generating it also switches on IMAP access.

providers.name: Seznam Email
providers.note: If the login fails, check that IMAP access is allowed in the Seznam webmail settings.

providers.name: WP Poczta
providers.note: Enable access first: in WP Poczta webmail open Opcje > IMAP/POP and allow IMAP.

providers.name: Onet Poczta
providers.note: Since 31 March 2026, IMAP needs a paid Poczta Plus or Standard plan (lifetime accounts excepted). Allow access to mail programs in the Onet mail settings.

providers.name: Interia Poczta
providers.note: Enable access first: Ustawienia > Ustawienia główne > Parametry, set 'I use an email program' to yes.

providers.name: Swisscom Bluewin
providers.note: Use the e-mail password, not the Swisscom Login password. You can change it in My Swisscom.

providers.name: Gmail
providers.note: Turn on 2-Step Verification, then create an app password at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords. Not available for work/school accounts, Advanced Protection, or security-key-only 2SV.

providers.name: Yahoo Mail
providers.note: Create an app password: Yahoo Account Security > Generate app password.

providers.name: AOL Mail
providers.note: Create an app password: login.aol.com > Account Security > Generate app password.

providers.name: iCloud Mail
providers.note: Turn on two-factor authentication, then create an app-specific password at account.apple.com > Sign-In and Security > App-Specific Passwords.

providers.name: Xfinity (Comcast)
providers.note: Turn on access for third-party email programs in Xfinity Email settings first. Then use your Xfinity ID password.

providers.name: AT&T Mail
providers.note: Create a 16-character Secure Mail Key in myAT&T > Profile > Sign-in info and use it as the password.

providers.name: Verizon (AOL-hosted)
providers.note: verizon.net mail is hosted by AOL. Create an app password at login.aol.com > Account Security > Generate app password.

providers.name: Cox (Yahoo-hosted)
providers.note: cox.net mail now runs on Yahoo. Create an app password in Yahoo Account Security > Generate app password.

providers.name: GMX (international)
providers.note: Enable IMAP first: Email > Settings > POP3 & IMAP > enable access via POP3 and IMAP. GMX switches it off again after long inactivity.

providers.name: Outlook.com / Hotmail
providers.unsupported: Microsoft removed password and app-password sign-in for IMAP in personal accounts in September 2024; only OAuth2 works.

providers.name: Microsoft 365 / Exchange Online (work)
providers.unsupported: Basic authentication for IMAP in Exchange Online was permanently disabled in 2022–2023; only OAuth2 is accepted.

providers.name: Proton Mail
providers.unsupported: IMAP is only offered through Proton Mail Bridge on localhost, whose self-signed certificate agent-mail does not trust.

providers.name: Tuta (Tutanota)
providers.unsupported: Tuta offers no IMAP access at all; mail is reachable only through its own apps.
